title: Paneflow configuration
description: Schema for paneflow.json. Lives at ~/.config/paneflow/paneflow.json on Linux, ~/Library/Application Support/paneflow/paneflow.json on macOS, and %APPDATA%\paneflow\paneflow.json on Windows. The runtime is lenient: unknown top-level keys are ignored, so the schema's `additionalProperties: false` is an editor-side aid, not a runtime constraint.

$schema.description: Pointer to this schema. Used by editors (VS Code, Zed, JetBrains) for autocomplete and validation. Ignored at runtime.

$schemaVersion.description: Schema version pin. Paneflow logs a warning when the value is unknown but never refuses to load the file.

default_shell.description: Shell binary path. When null or omitted, Unix falls back to $SHELL then /bin/sh. Windows falls back to PowerShell 7 (pwsh.exe), Windows PowerShell 5.1 (powershell.exe), %ComSpec%, C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe, then bare cmd.exe.

theme.description: Bundled theme name: the light or dark variant of one preset (Paneflow, Vercel, Claude, Cursor). Pre-preset names (One Dark, Vercel, Claude, Cursor) still resolve to their variant.

theme_mode.description: Theme selection mode. 'light' and 'dark' force the matching variant of the current preset. 'system' follows the current OS window appearance while keeping theme as the resolved concrete theme for older Paneflow versions.

font_family.description: Font family. Default: bundled JetBrainsMono Nerd Font Mono. Accepts the aliases '.PaneflowMono' and 'JetBrainsMono NFM' for that default, '.PaneflowSans' for bundled Geist, the concrete embedded names ('JetBrainsMono Nerd Font Mono', 'Geist Mono', 'Geist', 'Lilex', 'IBM Plex Mono', 'IBM Plex Sans'), or any installed system monospace family. Unknown families fall back to the default with a warning.

font_fallbacks.description: Ordered fallback font families consulted (in order) for glyphs the primary font_family does not cover - e.g. a Nerd Font for the Powerline/icon glyphs used by Starship, oh-my-posh or Terminal-Icons, which no system font provides on Windows. Null or an empty list keeps GPUI's built-in fallback stack only.

line_height.description: Line height as a multiplier of the font's own line height (ascent + descent + line gap). Default 1.0.

cell_width.description: Cell width as a multiplier of the font's advance. Default 1.0.

unfocused_pane_opacity.description: Opacity of panes that do not hold focus, when a workspace has more than one pane. 1.0 disables the dim. Default 0.7.

reduce_motion.description: Minimize non-essential interface motion: hover transitions settle instantly and decorative animations render a static frame. Default false.

sidebar_show.description: What the workspaces rail shows beyond a row's name. Everything off is the default rail.

branch.description: Show a session tab's git branch: its bound worktree's, or its workspace's when the tab is unbound. Default false.

diffstat.description: Show that same checkout's insertion and deletion counts. Default false.

pr.description: Mark a branch that already has a pull request: its icon becomes the pull-request glyph, colored by the request's state. Needs the 'gh' CLI, and answers for GitHub remotes only. Default false.

indent_guide.description: Draw a hairline under a workspace's folder icon, running down its tab rows. Default false.

window_decorations.description: Window decoration mode. 'client' = client-side decorations (custom title bar). 'server' = server-side decorations (compositor-drawn). Read once at startup; changes require a restart.

window_backdrop.description: Native window backdrop. 'auto' uses Mica on supported Windows 11 builds and opaque elsewhere; 'mica' forces Mica when supported; 'blurred'/'acrylic' opts into blur; 'transparent' keeps a transparent surface; 'opaque'/'off' disables native transparency. Read once at startup; PANEFLOW_WINDOW_BACKDROP overrides it for one launch.

windows_terminal_material.description: Windows-only. When true, CLI terminal default backgrounds are transparent so the active native window backdrop (Mica, blur, or transparent) can show through. Other platforms ignore this field.

windows_chrome_material.description: Windows-only. When true, the primary sidebar card reveals the active native window backdrop (Mica, blur, or transparent). Other platforms ignore this field.

macos_chrome_material.description: macOS-only. When true, the primary sidebar card reveals AppKit's native Sidebar material. Other platforms ignore this field.

option_as_meta.description: Treat Alt/Option as Meta and send an ESC prefix. Default true on Linux and Windows. On macOS, set to false if you rely on Option to produce Unicode characters.

shell_integration.description: Master switch for the per-shell rc injection (OSC 7 CWD reporting + OSC 133 command marks). null/true = enabled (default); false = no snippet is written or wired - the shell starts exactly as it would outside Paneflow.

agent_stall_detection.description: Master switch for Stalled agent detection. null/true = enabled (default): a Thinking agent session with no hook activity past agent_stall_threshold_secs is flagged Stalled, with ONE desktop notification per stall episode (the flag clears on the next hook event, so a legitimately long turn costs at most one notification). false = kill switch - no Stalled state is ever produced.

agent_stall_threshold_secs.description: Silence threshold in seconds before a Thinking agent session is flagged Stalled (a likely-lost ai.stop). Checked by a 30 s sweep, so the effective detection latency is threshold + up to 30 s. Out-of-range values are clamped.

review_prefill_delay_ms.description: Delay in milliseconds before the Review view types the review prompt into a freshly launched CLI. The prompt is always copied to the clipboard as a fallback, so raise this only if a slow-starting CLI keeps missing the auto-fill. Out-of-range values are clamped.

submit_paste_delay_ms.description: Base delay in milliseconds between writing a bracketed-paste burst to an agent pane and the separate carriage return that submits it (paneflow send --submit). The server then waits for the agent's paste echo before pressing Enter, so this is only the floor. Raise it if a slow agent keeps swallowing the submit. Out-of-range values are clamped.

external_editor.description: Editor used to open file links. 'auto' probes zed, cursor, windsurf, then code; 'system' always uses the OS opener.

shortcuts.description: Custom keybindings overriding the defaults. Format: { 'ctrl+t': 'new_tab' }. The full list of action names is defined in src-app/src/app/actions.rs.

ligatures.description: Render programming-font ligatures (FiraCode '=>', '!=', JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Code). Hot-reloaded.

integrated_glyphs.description: Draw built-in block-element glyphs as filled quads instead of using the font glyph. Hot-reloaded.

color_emoji.description: Render emoji with the platform color-emoji path. Hot-reloaded.

cursor_color.description: Cursor color override as #RRGGBB. Null uses the active color scheme cursor color.

scrollback_lines.description: Maximum scrollback history in lines for normal and agent terminals. Applied to newly-created terminals. Review and cached surfaces cap this value at 2000 and 1000 lines respectively. Live cached/hidden terminals are not rebuilt or killed to shrink history; exited cached terminals may be evicted by the cache policy.

cursor_shape.description: Default cursor shape before an application overrides it.

env.description: Environment variables injected into every new terminal. Per-surface values win on collision. TERM, COLORTERM, PANEFLOW_WORKSPACE_ID, PANEFLOW_SURFACE_ID, PANEFLOW_SOCKET_PATH, and PANEFLOW_BIN_DIR are protected at PTY spawn. LD_* and DYLD_* keys are dropped. PATH is accepted, but PANEFLOW_BIN_DIR is re-prepended so agent commands still route through the shim.

scroll_multiplier.description: Scroll-wheel multiplier outside mouse-reporting and alternate-screen modes. Applied when a terminal view is constructed.

minimum_contrast.description: Minimum APCA lightness contrast (Lc) enforced between text and its cell background, on the theme's ANSI colors only. 0 leaves theme colors untouched. Hot-reloaded.

commands.description: cmux-compatible command and workspace definitions, rendered in the workspace command palette.

claude_code_bypass_permissions.description: When true, the built-in 'Claude Code' tab-bar button launches the CLI with --permission-mode bypassPermissions, disabling all permission prompts. Per Anthropic's docs this mode offers no protection against prompt injection - opt in only on machines where that risk is acceptable.

ai_unrestricted.description: AI free-access mode. When true, a conductor (a CLI agent or external orchestrator) may auto-submit prompts to other panes (surface.send_text submit:true) WITHOUT the PANEFLOW_IPC_SCRIPTING env gate, and every such write is traced. Null/false (default) keeps the current behavior strictly unchanged. Re-evaluated per call, so toggling it off revokes the capability with no residual access.

ai_injection_fence.description: Anti-injection fence on the surface.read CLI/IPC path, independent of ai_unrestricted. Null/true (default) wraps returned terminal text in an <untrusted_terminal_output> marker so a malicious peer pane cannot hijack a conductor reading it. False returns raw text (an assumed risk). Stays ON by default even in free-access mode because the fence protects the AI, it does not bridle it.

agent_panel.description: Agents-view display, profile, and notification settings.

tool_permissions.description: Per-tool always-allow and always-deny input patterns.

telemetry.description: Opt-in desktop telemetry consent. The first-run consent modal only appears when 'enabled' is unanswered.

enabled.description: Tri-state consent: null = unanswered, true = opted in, false = opted out. The PANEFLOW_NO_TELEMETRY=1 environment variable overrides this unconditionally.

commandDefinition.description: Exactly one non-null payload: a workspace definition (set 'workspace') or a non-blank shell command (set 'command').

description.description: Human-readable description shown in the command palette.

command.description: Shell command string. Mutually exclusive with 'workspace'.

cwd.description: Default working directory for the workspace.

layout_preset.description: Visual workspace-builder preset. Mirrors paneflow up layout presets.

color.description: Workspace accent color as a 6-digit lowercase hex string (no leading #).

ratio.description: Legacy single ratio for binary (2-child) layouts. Ignored when 'ratios' is present.

ratios.description: Per-child ratios for N-ary layouts. When present, must match children length and sum to ~1.0.

surface_type.description: Surface kind. Currently only 'terminal' is rendered.

name.description: Display name for the surface tab.

custom_name.description: User-assigned surface name. When set, it overrides the auto-derived surface name and survives restart.

command.description: Shell command to run on surface creation.

prompt.description: Prompt text to prefill after launching an agent command.

cwd.description: Working directory override (relative paths resolve against the workspace cwd).

env.description: Extra environment variables merged over terminal.env. The same protected-key and loader-key filtering applies at PTY spawn.

focus.description: When true, this surface receives initial focus.

scrollback.description: Saved plain-text scrollback restored with the surface.

agent.description: Stable tag of the agent CLI last detected in this surface, such as 'claude_code'.

font_size.description: Per-surface font-size override in points. Null follows the global font_size.
